item: scripts/fault_harness.py: the crash pipeline end to end (real launcher and app in a throwaway install; fault injected from outside src/)
summary: Four scenarios (native-abort inside an open duckdb slot, sigsegv, sigkill, clean-stop): boot, fault, launcher exit, boot again, read /api/diagnostics/session-forensics and assert the previous-session evidence, plus that previous_session carries no passphrase canary, throwaway path or e-mail-shaped text. Slow (about 36 s a scenario), so skipped by default (OO_FAULT_HARNESS=1). It found a real gap on its first run: the native in-flight file was made by the first wired call, so a session killed before any left NO file and read as 'absent', not 'no-calls-recorded'; native_inflight.start() now makes it at boot (session_hwm.capture_previous). Nothing was added to src/ for the fault: a sitecustomize on PYTHONPATH and a signal from the harness.
